gap:logistic_l2_tuning.statement: Determine optimal L2 regularization strength in [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0] that minimizes 5-fold cross-validated Brier score for logistic regression.

gap:interaction_terms.statement: Test whether adding interaction terms (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improves Brier score on logistic regression via paired t-test across folds.

gap:model_compression.statement: Find the optimal configuration of sparsity (20, 40, 60%) and bit quantization (8, 4) that retains the highest dense-model Brier score performance.

claim:l2_tuning_result.statement: L2 regularization tuning via 5-fold cross-validation identified lambda=1.0 as optimal, reducing Brier score from 0.261428 (baseline) to 0.234497, an improvement of 0.026931.

claim:interaction_significance.statement: Paired t-test across 5 folds shows interaction terms (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improve logistic regression with lambda=0.1, with t-statistic of 4.0105 (p=0.016), exceeding threshold of t>2.0.

claim:compression_optimization.statement: Model compression testing identified sparsity20_bits4 as best configuration with 0.999222 retention ratio, achieving 20% sparsity and 4-bit quantization while preserving 99.9% of dense model Brier performance.
